Paragliding in Fethiye: The Complete 2026 Guide

Fethiye is the gateway to the world's most famous paragliding flight. Located on Turkey's stunning Turquoise Coast, Fethiye is the base town for all Babadağ Mountain tandem flights. Whether you're staying in Fethiye city center, Çalış Beach, Hisarönü, or Ölüdeniz, every paragliding operator picks you up from your hotel for free.

Unlike fly-in-fly-out paragliding spots, Fethiye offers a complete holiday ecosystem. You can combine your tandem paragliding flight with boat trips to Butterfly Valley, scuba diving, the Saklıkent Gorge, and the ancient ruins of Tlos and Kayaköy — all within 30 minutes of your hotel.

Where Exactly Does Fethiye Paragliding Take Place?

All Fethiye paragliding flights launch from Babadağ Mountain (1,960m), which rises directly above the coastal village of Ölüdeniz, 15km south of Fethiye center. The flight follows the mountain ridgeline, crosses over Kidrak Beach and the Blue Lagoon, and lands on Belcekiz Beach in Ölüdeniz. The total drive from Fethiye center to the launch point is approximately 40 minutes.

Hotel Pickup Areas in Fethiye

Free pickup from all these areas:

  • Fethiye City Center — all hotels, pensions, and Airbnbs
  • Çalış Beach — the long beachfront strip north of Fethiye
  • Hisarönü & Ovacık — the hillside resort villages between Fethiye and Ölüdeniz
  • Ölüdeniz — beachfront hotels near the Blue Lagoon

Best Time for Fethiye Paragliding

The Fethiye paragliding season runs April through November. July–August offers the longest flights with strong thermals. September–October has the smoothest, most stable air — ideal for first-timers. Every month during season is excellent for flying. Read our FAQ for detailed seasonal advice.

Is Paragliding in Fethiye Safe?

Yes — Fethiye/Ölüdeniz is one of the most heavily regulated paragliding sites in the world. All pilots must hold a THK T2 tandem license (500+ solo hours), and all equipment is EN 926 certified. SkyHigh carries $1M aviation insurance per passenger. Read our complete safety guide for technical details.

Coming from Nearby Cities?

Many visitors fly to Antalya or stay in Marmaris and make a day trip to Fethiye for paragliding. It's absolutely possible — Fethiye is 3 hours from Antalya and 2.5 hours from Marmaris by road. We can arrange your flight time around your travel schedule.
